title: Synthetic Detergent Powders for Household Use — Specification

clauses.title: Active Detergent and Total Phosphate Limits (Eco-Friendly Criteria)
clauses.text: Clause 4.1 & Table 1 (Chemical Composition of Household Detergent Powders): (a) Active Detergent (Surfactant) content: Grade 1 min 19.0%; Grade 2 min 16.0%; Grade 3 min 10.0%. (b) Total Phosphate as STPP: Eco-Mark detergent max 2.5% (to prevent water eutrophication). (c) pH of 1% solution shall be between 9.0 and 11.0. (d) Active Oxygen in oxygen bleach powders min 1.0%.
